title: E02 cold open demo — consequence first

segments.text: At seven forty-six in the morning, a customer opened a support ticket. Their entire site was gone.
Eight minutes earlier, a maintenance script had started its second batch. The first batch went exactly as planned.
Same script. Same green checks. But the second list did not point at apps. It pointed at the sites themselves.
Eight hundred and eighty-three sites. Deleted in twenty-three minutes.
And the monitoring said nothing. Because deleting a site was a normal workflow.
This is how a routine cleanup became a fourteen-day recovery. And the one check that would have stopped it.
